meta.name: AURA Design System
meta.generatedFrom: AURA design system artifact (tokens.json list format)

notes.violet-50: Primitive violet 50. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.violet-100: Primitive violet 100. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.violet-200: Primitive violet 200. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.violet-300: Primitive. Dark-theme aura-fg-accent (9.6:1 on dark aura-bg-surface).
notes.violet-400: Primitive. Dark-theme aura-accent-violet (6.5:1 on dark aura-bg-surface).
notes.violet-500: Primitive violet 500. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.violet-600: Primitive. Primary brand violet (Figma: 'Primary brand'). Never in product code directly — reach it through a semantic token.
notes.violet-700: Primitive. Light-theme accent: resolves aura-fg-accent and aura-accent-violet. 7.1:1 on aura-bg-surface.
notes.violet-800: Primitive violet 800. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.violet-900: Primitive violet 900. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens (token-lint forbids raw hex).
notes.zinc-0: Primitive white. Light aura-bg-surface, aura-fg-inverted; dark aura-fg-primary, aura-border-strong.
notes.zinc-300: Primitive zinc 300. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens.
notes.zinc-450: Primitive between zinc-400 and -500. Dark-theme aura-fg-tertiary (5.5:1 on dark surface). ADDED so tertiary text passes AA.
notes.zinc-500: Primitive zinc 500. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens.
notes.zinc-700: Primitive zinc 700. Reference only — code uses semantic tokens.
notes.zinc-800: Primitive. Dark aura-bg-surface-hover; primary button hover fill.
notes.zinc-900: Primitive 'Ink'. Light aura-fg-primary, aura-bg-surface-strong, aura-border-strong; dark aura-bg-surface; the brutal Creative shadow colour.
notes.lime-200: Primitive 'Accent dot'. aura-accent-dot / aura-accent-lime and the Ready status fill. A fill only — 1.17:1 against white, so never text and never a mark that must be seen on a light surface.
notes.lime-300: Primitive lime 300 (also exported in the Tailwind config).
notes.lime-800: Primitive. Success alert text on aura-lime-50 (6.8:1). ADDED.
notes.red-400: Primitive. Dark-theme aura-fg-danger: 6.4:1 on dark surface. ADDED.
notes.red-700: Primitive red 700 (Tailwind red, like the other scales). The Blocked status fill; white on it 6.5:1. ADDED — the source palette has no warm hue.
notes.amber-800: Primitive. Warning alert text (light), 6.8:1 on amber-50. ADDED.
notes.ink: Primitive ink (= zinc-950). Text on lime fills: the Ready status label (15:1 on aura-lime-200).
notes.white: Primitive white. The Creative button fill in every theme.
notes.bg-surface: Default surface: cards, tables, panels, page body. Grounds aura-fg-primary, -secondary and -accent.
notes.bg-surface-hover: Hover fill for rows, secondary buttons and list items. aura-fg-primary and -secondary still pass on it (≥5.8:1).
notes.bg-surface-strong: High-emphasis block (the wordmark tile, inverted callouts). Text on it: aura-fg-inverted.
notes.bg-canvas: App background behind surfaces; the data-table header band.
notes.bg-inverted: Inverted ground: tooltips. Text on it: aura-fg-inverted (17.7:1).
notes.fg-primary: Body and heading text on aura-bg-surface and aura-bg-canvas (≥16.9:1 both themes).
notes.fg-secondary: Supporting text, labels, captions on aura-bg-surface / -canvas / -surface-hover (≥5.8:1 both themes).
notes.fg-tertiary: Placeholders, hints, timestamps, breadcrumb separators. Fixed in 4.1 to pass AA: 4.8:1 light / 5.5:1 dark on aura-bg-surface, ≥4.6:1 on -canvas and -surface-hover. Not for text on aura-bg-selected (4.4:1).
notes.fg-accent: Links and accent text on aura-bg-surface / -canvas (≥6.8:1 light, ≥9.6:1 dark).
notes.border-default: Hairline dividers and card/table outlines. Decorative only: ~1.3:1, below the 3:1 a control boundary needs.
notes.border-strong: Creative 2px borders and any boundary that must be seen (17.7:1).
notes.border-subtle: Faintest separators inside a surface (e.g. between grouped list items).
notes.accent-dot: The lime signal dot beside the AURA wordmark and live/status dots. Visible on dark and strong grounds; invisible on white (1.17:1).
notes.accent-violet: Violet accent fills and marks (selection, focus-adjacent emphasis, charts' first series).
notes.accent-lime: Lime accent fill (highlights, the Ready status). Label on it in aura-ink.
notes.button-primary-bg: Component: Enterprise (primary) button fill — ink in light, white in dark, as the Storybook story renders it (tokens.json pins it to the light value, which disappears on the dark surface).
notes.button-primary-fg: Component: primary button label on aura-button-primary-bg (17.7:1 both themes).
notes.button-primary-bg-hover: Component: primary button hover. Light zinc-800 is the source value; dark zinc-200 is an ADDED value (the source has none — its zinc-800 hover hides the dark label at 1.19:1). Label 14.9:1 light, 14.0:1 dark.
notes.button-creative-bg: Component: Creative button fill (white in every theme). Label in aura-ink.
notes.card-border: Component: card outline (light value; use aura-border-default where the card must follow theme).
notes.focus-ring: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element: 2px solid, 2px offset. Lands on aura-bg-surface / -canvas / -surface-hover at ≥6.8:1 light and ≥5.4:1 dark. On mesh and grain surfaces the ring switches to aura-on-texture (violet-700 on the violet-400 pool is only 2.6:1). ADDED — the source defines no focus style.
notes.mesh-from: Creative mesh: the violet pool (top-left). Same in both themes — mesh is a light-surface treatment. ADDED from the source's 'violet → lime gradient'.
notes.mesh-ground: Creative mesh: the ground between the pools.
notes.on-texture: Text and icons on a mesh or grain surface in every theme: ≥7.3:1 on the darkest mesh point (violet-400), 15:1 on lime, 20:1 on white.
notes.grain: Grain speckle colour, drawn at aura-grain-opacity. Visible only on light grounds.
notes.status-neutral-bg: Status pill fill for not-started / unknown states (To Do, Draft). Dark theme uses a quiet zinc-800 fill so it sits below the coloured states. ADDED.
notes.status-neutral-fg: Label and icon on aura-status-neutral-bg (light 9.5:1, dark zinc-300 on zinc-800).
notes.status-progress-bg: Status pill fill for work under way (In Progress, In Review). Dark: a quiet violet-tinted fill (violet-500 at 20% over zinc-900) so the pill sits below the row text. ADDED; dark 4.11.
notes.status-progress-fg: Label and icon on aura-status-progress-bg (light 7.6:1; dark violet-300, 7.6:1).
notes.status-ready-bg: Status pill fill for finished / good states (Ready, Done). The source's lime pill. Dark: a lime-tinted fill (lime-400 at 14% over zinc-900). ADDED as a named token; dark 4.11.
notes.status-ready-fg: Label and icon on aura-status-ready-bg (light 15.2:1; dark lime-300, 9.9:1).
notes.status-blocked-bg: Status pill fill for stopped / failed states (Blocked, Failed). Dark on purpose: 5.5:1 lighter-to-darker against the lime Ready fill, so Ready and Blocked differ by lightness, not only red vs green. ADDED.
notes.bg-selected: Selected table rows and list items. Opaque so pinned columns can sit on it (dark = a 14% violet-400 wash over zinc-900, flattened). aura-fg-primary on it ≥14.2:1, aura-fg-secondary ≥5.5:1, focus ring ≥5.2:1 in both themes. ADDED.
notes.border-control: Outline of unchecked checkboxes and other small controls that must be seen: ≥4.4:1 on aura-bg-surface, -canvas and aura-bg-selected (the 3:1 a control boundary needs). ADDED.
notes.bg-skeleton: zinc-200 light / zinc-700 dark so bars read on white and on zinc-900 surfaces. Skeleton placeholder bars while a table or list loads. Decorative; the table carries aria-busy and a 'Loading rows' status for screen readers. ADDED.
notes.fg-danger: Error messages, destructive labels and invalid-field text on aura-bg-surface / -canvas: ≥6.2:1 light, ≥5.4:1 dark. ADDED.
notes.border-danger: Outline of an invalid input (≥5.4:1 on its ground). ADDED.
notes.bg-input: Text fields, selects, textareas. Always paired with a 1px aura-border-control outline. ADDED.
notes.bg-input-disabled: Disabled and read-only inputs; text on it stays aura-fg-secondary. ADDED.
notes.bg-scrim: The dimmed layer behind a Dialog. ADDED.
notes.alert-info-fg: Info alert title and icon: 8.2:1 light, 7.7:1 dark. Body text on the fill stays aura-fg-primary.
notes.alert-success-fg: Success alert title and icon: 6.8:1 light, 10.4:1 dark.
notes.alert-warning-fg: Warning alert title and icon: 6.8:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.
notes.alert-danger-fg: Danger alert title and icon: 5.9:1 light, 8.1:1 dark.
notes.drawer-sm: Drawer width, small (filters, quick detail). ADDED 4.2.
notes.container-max: Container max width — matches aura-bp-xl. ADDED 4.2.
notes.container-narrow: Narrow container for forms and reading. ADDED 4.2.
notes.cal-cell: Calendar day cell (DatePicker). 40px on touch screens via media query. ADDED 4.2.
notes.popover-max-height: Max height of Combobox listbox and DatePicker popover lists. ADDED 4.2.
notes.fg-positive: Rising-and-good numbers (Stat change, positive deltas) on aura-bg-surface / -canvas. Never on lime fills. ADDED 4.3.
notes.button-secondary-border: Component: secondary button (and secondary Button links) 1px edge. ≥3:1 on aura-bg-surface and -canvas in both themes (zinc-450 light 3.1–3.3:1, zinc-500 dark 3.7–4.1:1), so the pill is visible without its label. ADDED 4.7.1 (was aura-border-default, ~1.3:1).
notes.button-danger-bg: Component: variant="danger" fill — red-700 light (white label 6.5:1), red-600 dark (4.8:1; red-700 would sink to 2.7:1 against the dark surface). Only for irreversible or destructive actions — usually the confirm button of a Dialog role="alertdialog". ADDED 4.10.
notes.button-danger-bg-hover: Component: danger button hover — red-800 light, red-700 dark (white label ≥6.5:1). ADDED 4.10.
notes.button-danger-fg: Component: label on the danger fill. ADDED 4.10.
notes.red-800: Primitive red 800. Danger button hover only.
notes.red-600: Primitive red 600. Dark-theme danger button fill only.
notes.chart-1: Categorical chart colours chart-1…8, in this order: violet, teal, orange, blue, magenta, green, gold, rose. Every one is ≥3:1 on bg-surface and bg-canvas in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11), and neighbours alternate dark/mid lightness (about 2:1 apart) so they stay apart under colour-blindness. chart-1 follows the brand in createTheme. Label series too; colour is never the only cue. ADDED 4.10.
notes.chart-seq-1: Sequential ramp chart-seq-1…5 (low → high) for heatmaps and ordered buckets. seq-1 is the value closest to the surface; every step ≥3:1 on bg-surface. Brand hue in createTheme. ADDED 4.10.
notes.chart-grid: Chart grid lines. Decorative, no contrast target. ADDED 4.10.
notes.chart-axis: Axis lines, ticks and tick labels (text: 4.5:1 on bg-surface and bg-canvas). ADDED 4.10.
notes.progress-track: Empty part of Progress and FileUpload bars (fill). Its edge carries the 3:1. ADDED 4.11.
notes.progress-track-edge: 1px inset edge of Progress / upload tracks: ≥3:1 on bg-surface and bg-canvas in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11), so the track reads without the fill. ADDED 4.11.
notes.input-font-size: Text size in inputs, textareas, selects and pickers. Phones (<640px) use at least 16px so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus. ADDED 4.11.
notes.touch-target: Minimum hit area on touch screens (pointer: coarse): IconButton, and Radio / Checkbox / Switch rows (WCAG 2.5.5). ADDED 4.11.
notes.table-row-height: DataTable row and header height. 40px in compact density on fine pointers; 48px on touch. ADDED 4.14.
notes.sidenav-rail-width: SideNav collapsed to an icon-only rail (`collapsed`). ADDED 4.15.
notes.button-height-sm: Button size="sm": toolbars, table rows, card footers. Touch screens keep a 44px hit area around it. ADDED 4.16.
notes.bottomnav-height: BottomNav bar height above the safe-area inset; ActionBar in the viewport sits on top of it. ADDED 4.19.
notes.z-bar: Fixed and sticky page bars (BottomNav, ActionBar): above content, below dialogs, menus and toasts. ADDED 4.19.
